text: 中国14亿人口至少7亿男性，我们分门别类的研究一下吧。
en: China's 1.4 billion population includes at least 700 million men; let us examine them by category.

text: 01 力量型 争强好胜，绝不认错
en: 01 The Power Type: competitive and unwilling to admit defeat, never conceding fault.

text: 表层特征：
en: Surface characteristics:

text: 习惯以力量取胜，战斗力爆表，遇到冲突绝不妥协。
en: Habitually relies on strength to win, with combativeness off the charts, and never compromises when faced with conflict.

text: 常见于白羊座、狮子座、天蝎座男人。
en: Commonly found among Aries, Leo and Scorpio men.

text: 有女人表示表示：
en: A woman put it this way:

text: 短短一年，从温柔腼腆的萌妹子，生生被逼成了雷厉风行的女汉子。
en: In just one year, from a gentle, shy and adorable girl, she was driven into becoming a brisk and decisive tough woman.

text: 然而吵架依旧占不了上风，简直心力交瘁。
en: Yet she still cannot get the upper hand in arguments, and is utterly exhausted both mentally and physically.

text: 从筹备婚礼时娘家婆家的小矛盾，到夫妻小日子里生活习惯的差异，他永远都是以生死大决战的姿态回应：
en: From the minor friction between her family and his during wedding preparations to the differences in daily habits in their married life, he always responds with the posture of a fight to the death:

text: “你家人都是没事找事！
en: "Your family are all just making trouble out of nothing!

text: “这是我家，我爱把袜子放哪儿就放哪儿！
en: "This is my home; I'll put my socks wherever I bloody well please!

text: “玩个游戏怎么了，你还不是天天玩手机！
en: "What's wrong with playing a game? You're on your phone every day too!

text: 和他讲道理，无效；
en: Reasoning with him is ineffective;

text: 卖萌撒娇，被说是矫情；
en: Acting cute and coquettish gets branded as being overly sentimental;

text: 对吵，战火升级；
en: Arguing back only escalates the conflict;

text: 冷战，最后只能自己破冰；
en: In a cold war, in the end she can only be the one to break the ice;

text: 即使放出离家出走、摔门而去的终极大招，他也能至少坚持3天不联系、不服软。
en: Even when she plays the ultimate card of walking out and slamming the door, he can hold out for at least three days without making contact or backing down.

text: 真实一面：
en: The real side:

text: 力量型男人给自己写的人生剧本，是一部热血沸腾的战斗史。
en: The life script a Power Type man writes for himself is a heated tale of battle.

text: 他是代表正义、永不屈服的男主，所有给他“找茬”、挑他毛病的人，当然都是反派角色。
en: He is the male lead representing justice who never yields; everyone who "picks on" him or finds fault with him is of course a villain.

text: 输赢和强弱，绝对是关乎生死的大事。
en: Winning and losing, strength and weakness, are absolutely matters of life and death.

text: 因为在他心中，横着这样一个等式：输/犯错/服软=没有面子=不是男人=死了算了
en: Because in his heart there is this equation: losing / making a mistake / backing down = loss of face = not a real man = might as well be dead.

text: 他最怕示弱，而亲密关系偏偏太容易触发无力感。
en: He fears showing weakness the most, yet intimate relationships are precisely what so easily trigger a sense of powerlessness.

text: 卸下铠甲走近另一个人，内心最柔弱的地方也随之暴露，被伤害的风险大幅上升。
en: Laying down his armour to draw close to another person also exposes the softest part of his heart, and the risk of being hurt rises sharply.

text: 这个女人的老公是这样抱怨的：我对她掏心掏肺，可她三天两头把我当儿子训，一点面子都不给！
en: This woman's husband complained like this: "I pour my heart out to her, yet she lectures me like a son every other day and gives me no face at all!"

text: 于是，他用看起来更强大的暴力方式来应对。
en: Thus he responds with apparently more powerful forms of violence.

text: 而无论热暴力还是冷暴力，都有着同样的潜台词：我才是关系的主导者，你得听我的。
en: And whether it is hot or cold violence, the subtext is the same: I am the one in charge of this relationship, and you have to listen to me.

text: 面对冲突，女人很容易犯的一个错误，就是带着纠结和委屈率先道歉，试图让关系完好如初。
en: Facing conflict, an easy mistake for women is to apologise first out of tangled feelings and grievance, trying to restore the relationship to how it was.

text: 但在这种情况下，力量型男人接收到的讯息却是：你承认是你不对，就说明这件事情我完全没有责任。
en: But in this situation, the message the Power Type man receives is: you admit you were wrong, which means I bear no responsibility whatsoever for this matter.

text: 另一种常见错误是争勇斗狠，非要吵出个结果，或者拉来围观群众来评理。
en: Another common mistake is to fight fire with fire, insisting on arguing to a conclusion, or dragging in onlookers to pass judgement.

text: 很不幸，这样做的结果常常是激起他更强的战斗欲望，小事化大，大事直接变成埋着地雷的一团乱麻。
en: Unfortunately, the result of doing so often stirs up an even stronger will to fight in him, turning small matters into big ones and big ones directly into a tangled mess riddled with landmines.

text: 遭遇耿直不屈的力量型男人，女人该怎么办？
en: When facing an upright and unyielding Power Type man, what should a woman do?

text: 最聪明省力的方法，是不卑不亢，以柔克刚，循序渐进地培养他的共情力。
en: The smartest and least labour-intensive method is to remain neither servile nor arrogant, to overcome firmness with gentleness, and to cultivate his capacity for empathy step by step.

text: 无论当下有多生气，先稳住心神，采取平视姿态，既不随意服软，也不站在他的对立面。
en: No matter how angry you are in the moment, first steady your mind, adopt a level gaze, neither casually backing down nor standing in opposition to him.

text: 尝试理解他的情绪，并且表达出认同和肯定，等他的情绪平复、趋于理智时，再对他的具体行为提出自己的想法。
en: Try to understand his emotions and express recognition and affirmation; once his feelings have calmed and turned towards reason, then voice your own thoughts about his specific behaviour.

text: 力量型男人的暴躁，源于内在需求和情绪长期无法被看到。
en: The irascibility of a Power Type man stems from his inner needs and emotions long going unseen.

text: 他难以面对别人的感受，更缺乏对自己的共情。
en: He finds it hard to face others' feelings, and lacks even more the empathy for himself.

text: 所以，你的理解和接纳，不仅可以让他看到另一种沟通互动的可能性，也为他树立了一个自我接纳的榜样。
en: So your understanding and acceptance can not only let him see the possibility of another kind of communicative interaction, but also set him an example of self-acceptance.

text: 02 完美型 追根究底，超理性派
en: 02 The Perfectionist Type: gets to the bottom of things, the ultra-rationalist.

text: 表层特征：
en: Surface characteristics:

text: 自认为能以理服人，会在你即将爆发的时候毫无自觉性地压上一根又一根的稻草，还认为你无理取闹。
en: He believes he can convince others through reason, and will, without the slightest self-awareness, pile on straw after straw just as you are about to erupt, while thinking you are being unreasonable.

text: 常见于金牛座、处女座、摩羯座、水瓶座男人。
en: Commonly found among Taurus, Virgo, Capricorn and Aquarius men.

text: 对于感情，他们真的是在使用着“处理”的心态和方式。
en: Towards feelings, they really adopt the mindset and manner of "processing" them.

text: 一遇到问题，就像修复计算机病毒一样，隔离、杀毒、删除，井井有条、一丝不苟。
en: The moment a problem arises, it is like fixing a computer virus: isolate, disinfect, delete, all methodical and meticulous.

text: 《生活大爆炸》里的谢耳朵，就是这类男人登峰造极之后的状态。
en: Sheldon from The Big Bang Theory is the state such men reach at the pinnacle of their development.

text: 真实一面：
en: The real side:

text: 一个男人总要做到完美，是因为对他来说，最奢侈的不是成功，而是放松。
en: A man who always has to be perfect does so because, for him, the greatest luxury is not success but relaxation.

text: 为什么不能放松？
en: Why can he not relax?

text: 因为三个字：不信任。
en: Because of three words: distrust.

text: 不信任这个世界，所以总是不能解下盔甲，总觉得自己一旦放松警惕，就会有不测发生，不知道哪里就来一头狼，扑向自己的要害部位。
en: He distrusts the world, so he can never take off his armour, always feeling that the moment he lets his guard down, something untoward will happen, and a wolf will appear from nowhere to pounce on his vital parts.

text: 更不相信自己可以在这伤害之后幸存。
en: He distrusts even more his own ability to survive such harm.

text: 这样的人，往往小时候生存条件不好，考试99.5分，回家之路都会变得艰难无比，父母那张憋红的脸和握紧的青筋暴露的拳头，就已经告诉你，在这个世界上平安无事地生活下去，是一件多么艰难的事情。
en: Such a person often had a poor upbringing; scoring 99.5 on an exam could make the walk home unbearably hard, and the parents' flushed, tense faces and clenched fists with veins standing out already told you just how difficult it is to live safely in this world.

text: 有位读者写邮件给我，抱怨她的技术男老公：意见一致的时候，我是他老婆；意见不一致，我就成了“对方辩友”！
en: A reader wrote to me, complaining about her tech-geek husband: "When we agree, I'm his wife; when we don't, I become his 'opposing debater'!"

text: 随便举两个例子，都是血和泪：
en: Just two random examples, both full of blood and tears:

text: “工作压力大，办公室人际关系复杂，回家无意中唠叨两句，老公立刻辩驳了我的逻辑漏洞，并且要求我改正。
en: "Work stress is high, office relationships are complicated, and when I got home and absent-mindedly grumbled a bit, my husband immediately pointed out the logical flaws in my argument and demanded I correct them.

text: “情人节暗示老公送礼物，被他用一个三段论的逻辑推理直接打回。
en: "On Valentine's Day I hinted that my husband should give me a gift, and he rejected it outright with a syllogistic logical deduction.

text: 超理性的完美型男人，总是下意识地把逻辑学知识运用在亲密关系里，试图建立起一个有秩序感的小世界，里面很安全，而且能充分掌控局面。
en: The ultra-rational Perfectionist man always subconsciously applies his knowledge of logic to intimate relationships, trying to build a small orderly world that feels safe and lets him fully control the situation.

text: 谢耳朵就会要求艾米签订恋爱协议，条文繁琐地规范了双方的交往方式。
en: Sheldon, for instance, would demand that Amy sign a relationship agreement, with verbose clauses regulating how the two of them interact.

text: 包括约会时间、身体接触，试图把所有不可控的因素都纳入控制中，固执到坚不可摧。
en: Including dating times and physical contact, he tries to bring every uncontrollable factor under control, stubborn to the point of being impregnable.

text: 所以，别指望他们突然开窍、敏感地体贴到你的需求了，你得清晰明确地说出来。
en: So don't expect them to suddenly see the light and sensitively attend to your needs; you have to state them clearly and explicitly.

text: 我回复那位读者，建议她采取“理性沟通+提出改进建议”的方式，来破解和完美型男人的关系困局：
en: I replied to that reader, suggesting she adopt the approach of "rational communication plus proposing improvements" to break the relationship deadlock with a Perfectionist man:

text: ❶ 沟通之前，用“积极关注”的技术做铺垫。
en: 1) Before communicating, use the technique of "positive regard" as a foundation.

text: 充分认同他思考和做事的认真态度，对他的才能表示欣赏；
en: Fully acknowledge his serious attitude in thinking and acting, and show appreciation for his abilities;

text: ❷ 指出他某个地方存在不足，可以做得更好，激发他强迫症式的好奇心；
en: 2) Point out where he falls short and could do better, stirring his obsessive curiosity;

text: ❸ 不带攻击性地提出建议和观点。
en: 3) Offer suggestions and views in a non-aggressive way.

text: 比如，告诉他你在某个情况下会有怎样的感受，希望得到他怎样的回应或支持；
en: For example, tell him how you would feel in a certain situation and what kind of response or support you hope to get from him;

text: ❹ 引导他换位思考。
en: 4) Guide him to see things from another's perspective.

text: 在适当的时机提问：如果你是某某，遇到这样的情况，你会怎么想？
en: Ask at the right moment: if you were so-and-so, how would you feel facing such a situation?

text: 不久后的一天，当她再次忍不住说起办公室的勾心斗角时，老公居然安静地听完，然后说了一句人话：是啊，遇到这事是够烦心的，换了我，我也受不了。
en: Not long after, one day when she could not help but bring up the office intrigue again, her husband actually listened quietly to the end, then said something human: "Yes, running into that would be maddening; if I were in your shoes, I couldn't stand it either."

text: 03 活泼型 生命不息，玩心不止
en: 03 The Lively Type: life goes on, and so does the urge to play.

text: 表层特征：
en: Surface characteristics:

text: 活泼贪玩，好像永远都长不大，一副熊孩子的做派，缺乏责任感和稳定性。
en: Lively and play-loving, as if he will never grow up, with the ways of a naughty child, lacking a sense of responsibility and stability.

text: 常见于双子座、射手座男人。
en: Commonly found among Gemini and Sagittarius men.

text: 灰头土脸带着娃的新手妈妈，躺在沙发上打游戏的年轻爸爸，这场景是不是很熟悉？
en: A bedraggled new mum with the child in her arms and a young dad lounging on the sofa playing games — does this scene seem familiar?

text: 不过，这还算比较初阶的。
en: But this is still fairly elementary.

text: 我听过的最夸张的故事，是结婚近3年，刚怀上宝宝，正在努力供房和攒奶粉钱的关口上，老公沉迷网游，砸了几十万买装备。
en: The most extreme story I have heard is of a couple married nearly three years, just pregnant, right at the point of struggling to pay the mortgage and save for baby formula, when the husband became addicted to online games and splashed out hundreds of thousands on equipment.

text: 相比起来，聊聊骚、看看性感女主播什么的，都是家常便饭，不值一提。
en: By comparison, flirting a little or watching sexy female streamers is all in a day's work, not worth mentioning.

text: 在活泼型男人眼中，世界就是个超大型游乐场，要玩得尽兴，要创造够刺激的生命体验，自由自在，才不算白活一辈子。
en: In the eyes of a Lively Type man, the world is a giant playground; to play to one's heart's content, to create thrilling life experiences, to be free — only then is a life not lived in vain.

text: 真实一面：
en: The real side:

text: 这样的男人，很可能有着“整个人生都不许出差错”的父母。
en: Such a man likely has parents who demanded that "not a single thing in life may go wrong".

text: 他们当了一辈子兢兢业业的蚂蚁，就是为了储备下粮食，让孩子能够像蟋蟀一样，尽情欢唱。
en: They were diligent ants all their lives, simply to stockpile food so their child could sing freely like a cricket.

text: 于是父母会为他各种出格的、追求自我的行为点赞，就像熊孩子追着别人踩，妈妈虽然嘴上制止了，可脸上不禁露出甜蜜的微笑：唉，这孩子。
en: Thus the parents applaud his various outlandish, self-seeking behaviours; like a naughty child chasing others to stomp on them, the mother may verbally stop him, yet a sweet smile creeps onto her face: ah, this child.

text: 于是孩子就承接了父母的“投射”，如其所愿地轻轻松松地玩了，把责任和义务都交给父母，但是这样的活着有一种痛苦，那就是没有深度，没有意义。
en: Thus the child takes on the parents' "projection", playing carefreely as they wished, handing all responsibility and duty to the parents — yet such a way of living carries a pain, which is having no depth and no meaning.

text: 他的内心深处，一片虚无，像烟花散尽后的冷灰。
en: Deep in his heart lies emptiness, like the cold ash after fireworks have faded.

text: 于是只能用更强烈的刺激来填补空洞。
en: So he can only use ever stronger stimulation to fill the void.

text: 刚恋爱的时候，他可以给你无穷无尽的惊喜，就算你是冰山美人，也会不由自主地被吸引。
en: When first in love, he can give you endless surprises; even if you are an ice-queen beauty, you will be drawn to him involuntarily.

text: 但是，激情期、权力争夺期、整合期是所有亲密关系的必经之路。
en: But the passion stage, the power-struggle stage and the integration stage are the inevitable path of all intimate relationships.

text: 要发展长期关系，必须熬过最痛苦的权力争夺期。
en: To develop a long-term relationship, one must endure the most painful power-struggle stage.

text: 活泼型男人往往这一阶段表现糟糕，让另一半忍无可忍。
en: Lively Type men often perform badly in this stage, driving their partner beyond endurance.

text: 一方面是因为激情本身就是短暂的，熊熊烈火不可能燃烧到永远，先热后冷，给女人造成了严重的心理落差；
en: On the one hand, because passion itself is fleeting, a raging fire cannot burn forever; warming first then cooling leaves women with a severe psychological gap;

text: 另一方面，只有激情而缺乏更深层的共情与默契，会导致关系一直处于低位徘徊的状态。
en: On the other hand, having only passion but lacking deeper empathy and rapport leads the relationship to linger at a low ebb.

text: 此时，如果出现一个新的诱惑，无论是游戏还是女人，都可能把脆弱的感情推下悬崖。
en: At this point, if a new temptation appears, be it a game or a woman, it may push the fragile relationship off the cliff.

text: 他自身需要成长，找到自由与责任之间的平衡点。
en: He himself needs to grow, to find the balance between freedom and responsibility.

text: 作为他的伴侣，你可以使用的最佳策略是“顺势而为”：投其所好，物尽其用。
en: As his partner, the best strategy you can use is to "go with the flow": humour his interests and make the best use of things.

text: ❶ 首先，抓住他的核心需求“玩”。
en: 1) First, grasp his core need: "play".

text: 然后试着和他达成共识，做些“交换”：你做完了某件事情，然后就可以去玩，我给你100%的自由。
en: Then try to reach agreement with him on some "exchange": once you've finished a certain task, you may go and play, and I'll give you 100% freedom.

text: ❷ 其次，想办法利用他爱玩会玩的长处。
en: 2) Second, find ways to make use of his strength in loving and knowing how to play.

text: 如果有宝宝，就把陪宝宝玩耍的任务交给他，而不是一味强迫他要半夜起来帮宝宝换尿布。
en: If there is a baby, hand him the task of playing with the baby, rather than stubbornly forcing him to get up in the middle of the night to change nappies.

text: 活泼型男人渴望被喜欢和关注，在他表现良好时，记得给予正面反馈，强化他的成就感，创造良性循环。
en: Lively Type men crave being liked and noticed; when he behaves well, remember to give positive feedback, reinforcing his sense of achievement and creating a virtuous cycle.

text: 04 温和型 维稳第一，逃避问题
en: 04 The Gentle Type: stability first, and avoiding problems.

text: 表层特征：
en: Surface characteristics:

text: 平时体贴关爱，很在意你的感受，一吵架就缴械投降，说不出哪里不好，但总觉得郁闷。
en: Usually considerate and caring, very attentive to your feelings, but surrenders the moment you quarrel, unable to say what is wrong, yet always feeling depressed.

text: 常见于巨蟹座、天秤座、双鱼座男人。
en: Commonly found among Cancer, Libra and Pisces men.

text: 温和型男人绝大多数都带有暖男属性。
en: The vast majority of Gentle Type men have the qualities of a warm man.

text: 然而在一起久了，你会产生一种遭遇通货膨胀的感觉：
en: Yet after being together a long time, you get a feeling of having encountered inflation:

text: 他给你很多很多爱，但里面水分太重，像海市蜃楼。
en: He gives you a great deal of love, but it is too full of water, like a mirage.

text: 真实一面：
en: The real side:

text: 一旦有冲突，我就完蛋了！
en: The moment there's conflict, I'm done for!

text: 这类男人会压抑到极点才爆发，他们内心有一个假定就是一旦冲突起来，关系就没办法再恢复到好的状态了，所以他会一直维系，到忍不下去彻底绝望的时候才会说出来。
en: This kind of man suppresses until the breaking point before erupting; in their hearts is the assumption that once conflict arises, the relationship can never return to a good state, so he keeps it going until he can no longer bear it and is utterly despairing before he speaks out.

text: 他们内心里没有解决问题的成人模式，要么是忍耐的父母，要么是忍耐的小孩，他们是极度不认可用冲突的方式来解决问题的。
en: In their hearts there is no adult model for solving problems; they are either the enduring parent or the enduring child, and they utterly reject using conflict as a way to resolve issues.

text: 曾经问过一个劈腿N次的男人：既然口口声声说感情早已不在，为什么不直接和女朋友挑明？
en: I once asked a man who had cheated N times: since you keep saying the feelings are long gone, why not tell your girlfriend outright?

text: 他的理由很老套：怕伤害她，毕竟谈了好几年了。
en: His reason was a cliché: afraid of hurting her, after all they'd been together several years.

text: 他对女友的好众所周知。
en: His kindness to his girlfriend is known to all.

text: 即使是在劈腿之后，仍然可以比绝大多数忠贞不二的男人更能体贴到女友的心理需求，在第一时间回应。
en: Even after cheating, he can still be more attuned to his girlfriend's psychological needs and respond immediately than the vast majority of faithful men.

text: 只是，他对其他女人也同样关爱有加，绝对遵从着先人后己的原则，贴心忍让，大爱无私。
en: It is just that he shows the same lavish care to other women, absolutely following the principle of others before self, considerate and yielding, with selfless great love.

text: 对谁都好得离谱，对谁都比对自己好，生怕言行不慎，引发冲突。
en: He is absurdly good to everyone, better to anyone than to himself, terrified that a careless word or deed might spark conflict.

text: 打着不伤害别人的旗号，其实是在逃避自己最真实的愧疚感。
en: Under the banner of not hurting others, he is in fact fleeing from his own most genuine guilt.

text: 这个男人善良、简单，甚至从不主动撩妹，每次的劈腿都始于对方示好，他不忍心拒绝，然后便藕断丝连地纠缠不清。
en: This man is kind and simple, never even taking the initiative to flirt with girls; every one of his affairs began with the other party showing interest, and unable to refuse, he became entangled in a lingering, ambiguous tie.

text: 想想看，一个离自己那么远、完全不肯面对内在感受的人，怎么可能全心全意地爱别人？
en: Just think: how could someone so distant from himself, who absolutely refuses to face his inner feelings, possibly love another wholeheartedly?

text: 他要么逃进工作、事业和兴趣爱好里，要么不断地借助新的关系来粉饰太平，逃避问题。
en: He either escapes into work, career and hobbies, or constantly uses new relationships to paper over the cracks and avoid problems.

text: 如果你的他恰好也有不愿表达感受、过度迁就却不够走心的倾向，怎么办？
en: If your man happens to share the tendency of being unwilling to express feelings, of over-indulging yet not being truly present, what should you do?

text: ❶ 终极原则是，促使他厘清和表达真实的感受。
en: 1) The ultimate principle is to prompt him to clarify and express his true feelings.

text: 你可以用这样的语句来启发他：
en: You can use words like these to draw him out:

text: 我知道你很珍惜这段感情，但如果我们不能坦诚地沟通，说出心里话，那可能会导致更多的误会，伤害我们的关系。
en: "I know you treasure this relationship, but if we cannot communicate honestly and speak our minds, it may lead to more misunderstandings and hurt our relationship."

text: ❷ 与此同时，营造放松的沟通氛围，放慢语速，尽量给他足够的安全感。
en: 2) At the same time, create a relaxed atmosphere for communication, slow your speech, and give him as much security as you can.

text: 在某些情况下，你可能还需要耐心地强调几次“我不会骂你的”、“我不会笑你的”。
en: In some cases, you may also need patiently to emphasise a few times, "I won't scold you" and "I won't laugh at you".

text: 当他说出感受时，不要给出正确性和道德性的评判。
en: When he speaks his feelings, do not pass judgement on their correctness or morality.

text: 人与人之间有差异，这是无比正常的现象，他和你想法不同，也并不代表他不爱你，或者故意和你作对。
en: Differences between people are an utterly normal phenomenon; that he thinks differently from you does not mean he doesn't love you or is deliberately opposing you.

text: 亲密关系中有两大终极难题：了解对方的真实需求、调整自己的应对模式。
en: There are two ultimate difficulties in intimate relationships: understanding the other's true needs, and adjusting one's own response patterns.

text: 前者难在人与人差异巨大，女人习以为常的观念，对男人来说可能就是天方夜谭，反之亦然。
en: The former is difficult because people differ vastly; notions women take for granted may be sheer fantasy to men, and vice versa.

text: 后者难在你要放下自我防卫，放下“主动改变=没面子/被动/处于低位”的恐慌，从爱情幻梦中走出来，去主动建立你想要的亲密关系。
en: The latter is difficult because you must lower your self-defence, let go of the panic that "taking the initiative to change = loss of face / being passive / being in a lower position", step out of the romantic fantasy, and take the initiative to build the intimate relationship you want.

text: 谁痛苦，谁改变。
en: Whoever suffers, changes.

text: 谁改变，谁受益。
en: Whoever changes, benefits.

text: 做不到也没关系，先从爱自己开始吧！
en: It's all right if you can't manage it; start with loving yourself!

text: 毕竟，爱自己，才是终身浪漫的开始。
en: After all, loving yourself is the beginning of a lifelong romance.
